project.name: portfolio
project.identity: A public Vite and React portfolio surface that projects evidence-backed project status through an explicit content and tracker allowlist.
project.audience: Hiring managers, recruiters, collaborators, and public readers evaluating the owner's active work.
project.core_loop: Select approved project evidence, render a clear public status and work narrative, let a visitor inspect the relevant project surface, and keep the projection aligned with source truth.
project.north_star: A public visitor can understand what the owner has built and its current status without the portfolio overstating unverified work or exposing private context.
not_this: A projection of every local repository or dirty state
A marketing surface that promotes unsupported claims

mvp.definition: The public app renders an allowlisted set of projects and status claims with clear navigation and source-bounded content.

complete_product.definition: The portfolio maintains a trustworthy public projection of selected work with current evidence, accessible presentation, stable deployment, and explicit privacy boundaries.

outcomes.name: Public project status and descriptions come from approved evidence and preserve uncertainty instead of inventing completion.

layers.intended: Visitors receive an accurate, useful picture of selected work.
layers.planned: The project defines an explicit content and tracker allowlist.
layers.implemented: The Vite/React app provides the public projection surface.
layers.verified: Local repository content supports the surface; hosted freshness and deployment behavior were not checked here.

evidence.note: Defines the portfolio app and evidence-backed status projection.

blockers.summary: Current deployment, content freshness, and public/private projection parity need live verification.
